svg.title: Machtiani: 100 turns without compaction
svg.desc: Animated diagram. The Machtiani planner asks questions, a shell agent works step by step and delegates to Claude Code, Codex, OMP and OpenCode in isolated contexts, and only small answers return. After 100 turns the planner has used about 30 percent of its context window.
svg.text: A planner that only asks questions, and a helper that answers them.

g.text: 1. The planner’s memory holds only questions and answers
2. For each question, a helper forks that exact memory and does the work
3. Only the answer goes back; the helper’s work is thrown away
Now watch it run for 100 turns
Shell agent works step by step
Quick steps, Codex and OMP work
